scope: Read-only spring API inspection before independent coupon experiments; source declarations do not replace runtime verification.
findings: Pinned Rust SpringJoint::new uses coupled linear axes, a position motor at rest_length and MotorModel::ForceBased.
The JS Rust wrapper calls SpringJointBuilder::new with caller stiffness/damping and both body-local anchors.
Native forces use the engine length scale. No physical magnet calibration is implied.
